sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (p.traits ->> $3::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[Tt ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?([Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' AND pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at >= CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (p.traits ->> $3::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[Tt ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?([Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' AND pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END) >= $4::float8), false)) AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (p.traits ->> $3::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[Tt ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?([Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' AND pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $5::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $5::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $5::text))::float8 END END) FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at >= CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (p.traits ->> $3::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[Tt ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?([Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' AND pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $3::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $3::text))::timestamptz END END) > $6::float8), false))))
